name: @usrp/feature-identity
description: NID verification, OTP challenge, applicant session, consent receipts, and the officer and citizen sign-in screens every app mounts (ADR-FE-007 §5).
//dependencies: @usrp/api-client supplies the ONE contract-asserted transport; this slice used to declare a phantom SliceTransport with no implementation, which is how three of its four operation ids came to name routes the edge does not serve. @usrp/auth owns officer login and the citizen OTP pair (ADR-016, ADR-018) and returns a session view with NO token — this slice consumes it and must never reimplement it.
//peerDependencies: React, ReactDOM and the router are PEERS, not dependencies. The host app owns the single instance; a second React in the graph throws 'invalid hook call' and resolves context to the wrong provider. The devDependency copies exist only so this slice typechecks and tests standalone.
//exports: Two narrow entry points so each host imports only the sign-in it mounts: the officer apps never reach the citizen OTP flow and the portal never reaches officer sign-in (S02 review). The barrel still exports both for model consumers.
